learn.title: Monitoring design: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, alerts and insights
objectives: Choose between metrics and logs, and between metric, log search, activity log and health alerts
Design application monitoring with workspace-based Application Insights, OpenTelemetry and availability tests
Select insights for VMs, containers, networks and hybrid servers (VM insights, Container insights, Network Watcher, Azure Arc)
Design notification and visualisation with action groups, alert processing rules, workbooks, dashboards and Azure Managed Grafana
Use Service Health, Resource Health, Azure Advisor and Defender for Cloud to monitor platform health, best practice and security posture
concepts: Azure Monitor Metrics
Lightweight numeric time series, near real time, platform metrics kept 93 days; best for fast, cheap alerts.
Azure Monitor Logs
Log Analytics workspace data queried with KQL; best for complex correlation and investigation.
Application Insights
APM feature of Azure Monitor; workspace-based resources store telemetry in Log Analytics and support distributed tracing.
Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry Distro
Microsoft's recommended vendor-neutral way to instrument apps for Application Insights.
Standard availability test
Synthetic test from Azure locations with SSL certificate checks, custom headers and HTTP verbs; replaces URL ping tests.
VM insights
Performance and dependency map for Azure VMs and Arc-enabled servers using the Azure Monitor Agent (map needs the Dependency agent).
Container insights and managed Prometheus
Container logs go to Log Analytics; Prometheus metrics go to an Azure Monitor workspace, often viewed in Azure Managed Grafana.
Network Watcher
Regional network tools: connection monitor, VNet flow logs, traffic analytics, IP flow verify, next hop, packet capture.
Action group
Reusable set of notifications (email, SMS, voice, push) and actions (webhook, Logic App, Function, runbook, Event Hubs, ITSM).
Alert processing rule
Modifies fired alerts at scale: suppress notifications on a schedule or add action groups without editing rules.
Service Health vs Resource Health
Service Health: Azure incidents, maintenance and advisories for your subscriptions; Resource Health: health of one specific resource.
Azure Advisor and Defender for Cloud
Advisor gives cost, reliability, performance, security and operational recommendations; Defender for Cloud gives secure score and threat protection.
comparisons: Metric alert vs log search alert
Metric alerts are faster and cheaper on numeric data; log search alerts run KQL for complex conditions across tables.
Workbooks vs dashboards vs Managed Grafana
Workbooks for interactive parameterised analysis; dashboards for pinned at-a-glance tiles; Managed Grafana for Grafana users and multi-source dashboards.
Sampling reduces volume but keeps correlated, statistically valid data; a daily cap stops ingestion completely once reached.
Connection monitor tests continuously and alerts; connection troubleshoot is a one-time reachability check.
VNet flow logs vs NSG flow logs
VNet flow logs are the current option; NSG flow logs are being retired and can no longer be newly created.
Service Health vs Resource Health alerts
Use Service Health for platform-wide incidents in your regions; use Resource Health for availability of specific resources.
traps: The Log Analytics agent (MMA) is retired; hybrid and Azure designs use the Azure Monitor Agent, with Azure Arc for non-Azure machines.
Classic Application Insights and URL ping tests are retired; pick workspace-based resources and standard tests.
Alert processing rule suppression stops notifications only; the alerts still fire and appear in the portal.
Prometheus metrics live in an Azure Monitor workspace, not a Log Analytics workspace.
Service Health alerts are created per subscription; Resource Health is per resource, not per region.
A daily cap is a safety net, not a cost-tuning tool; it drops all data after the limit.
revision: Fast numeric alerts: metric alert; complex KQL conditions: log search alert; resource operations: activity log alert.
Seasonal patterns: dynamic thresholds. Many VMs in one region: one multi-resource metric alert.
Maintenance windows: alert processing rule with a schedule. Shared recipients: one action group.
Microservices tracing: Application Insights with OpenTelemetry and Application Map.
Private endpoint availability: custom TrackAvailability test from inside the network.
AKS: Container insights plus managed Prometheus plus Azure Managed Grafana.
Hybrid latency: connection monitor; packet inspection: packet capture; NSG block check: IP flow verify.
On-premises, AWS or GCP servers: Azure Arc, then Azure Monitor Agent, VM insights and Defender for Servers.
